about: Lane preset overlay (docs/plans/v2.6/15-model-config.md). adolion-fresh seed applies ONE variant to the LANE's copied preset files, the matching settings.json mirrors (power_user.instruct / power_user.context / textgenerationwebui_settings when that preset is the active one), named settings.json fields and named Connection Manager profiles, before the lane server starts; every value is read back and a missing preset, key or profile fails the seed with nothing written. The real install is never touched. --preset-overlay <variant> picks one (default below), --no-preset-overlay reproduces the copied install.
